description: Compute the Hong Kong Public Transport Fare Subsidy Scheme amount for one month, from the expenses recorded under an Octopus account and an AlipayHK account. Rule taken verbatim from the Government page: one-third of the monthly public transport expenses in excess of a $500 threshold, capped at $400 per month per account; the two accounts are never combined. Returns both the truncated whole-dollar figure and the exact one-third figure. Deterministic arithmetic only. Read-only. No key required.

alipay.description: Public transport expenses in HKD recorded under the AlipayHK account this month (0 if none).

octopus.description: Public transport expenses in HKD recorded under the Octopus account this month (0 if none).

name: subsidy_amount
